RATE_TRANSIENT.meaning: roll and pitch rate in the first 0.2 s after the event, projected on motor m's thrust-loss axis, against before. Context; valid only when the event time is accurate to a fraction of 0.2 s

expected_inputs: a PX4 ULog with the stock topics (stock_log.py)
fault_behavior: a statistic that cannot be computed is UNAVAILABLE (INPUTS_MISSING), never NOMINAL
